Together we will be attempting (emphasis on attempting…) a series of Taskmaster challenges to win the Taskmaster trophy!

More importantly, we’ll be raising money to help build the new, world-leading Children’s Cancer Centre at GOSH, supporting seriously ill children and their families.

Join us on @Taskmaster’s YouTube from 5pm BST this Saturday 5th September to support an incredible cause.".
